# Free Banner Maker

> Free browser-based tool to create custom banners for your GitHub profile README. Pick a template, style, and text; preview live; download as PNG. No account required.

## Key features

- Browser-based banner editor with presets for GitHub profile headers
- Live preview before download
- PNG export ready to drop into your GitHub profile README
- Free to use; optional $1 custom AI-generated banner via Gumroad
